method: Acceptance rates are excluded. Ranks below are a provisional advising order for academic/route compatibility, assuming equal base admit rates, using dated transcript GPA, curricular preparation, pathway eligibility, degree sequencing and evidence quality. They are not statistically estimated likelihoods; no dataset supports calibrated personal probabilities. Adjacent positions are low-confidence and may reverse with current grades, major choice or credit evaluation.

profile.title: Life-story spine
profile.text: Military service preceded Broward College; housing instability disrupted that period, followed by treatment, transitional housing, nonprofit-program leadership, and SCAD. The August workbook records 900+ program hours and mentoring; exact dates, program name, role and partner relationships still need supporting records.
profile.source: Workbook Part I; sensitive context for optional disclosure, not a required essay theme.

profile.title: Academic baseline
profile.text: Broward: 3.04 and 22 earned semester credits (January 14, 2025 copy). SCAD: 3.33 and 30 quarter credits (October 3, 2026 copy), with term GPA rising from 3.00 to 3.66 and Dean’s List; roughly 42 earned semester equivalents total.
profile.source: October 22 transcript review; stale baseline, not current official standing or transferable-credit determination.

profile.title: Academic strengths and gaps
profile.text: A grades in government, criminal law, geometry, business and story foundations; six Broward withdrawals, a D in computer literacy and C in drawing/religion need context. Composition, statistics, economics, science and current completion history matter more than additional project volume.
profile.source: October transcript review; do not count developmental literacy as composition without evaluation.

profile.title: Intellectual interests
profile.text: People, organizations, Black/Africana studies, technology ethics, public policy, creative ownership, design and human agency form the current center. Robotics/AI are methods; most current school notes explicitly avoid CS as the default major.
profile.source: Current schools.json lenses supersede older CS-first planning.

profile.title: Humanities and personality
profile.text: Comparative philosophy, faith/theology, Mandarin and creative writing appear in the portfolio audit. The screenshot quick answers suggest playful superhero and science-fiction interests, music, curiosity, and ambition; these are cues to explore, not personality diagnoses.
profile.source: July portfolio audit and November screenshots; language proficiency, publications and metrics require verification.

profile.title: Campus contribution
profile.text: SCADhome mentoring/residence-life work, veteran lacrosse participation and residence-hall technology appear in the records. Rice screenshot drafts describe a four-floor responsibility, a Lacoste opportunity, and interactive floor plans; verify titles, scope, dates and individual contribution before using them.
profile.source: Fact sheet, October review and user-written screenshot draft; self-reported details require confirmation.

profile.title: Projects with useful evidence
profile.text: Great Books Semantic Engine and NYC Best Structure were reviewed as working artifacts in July; use disclosed scale, method and limitations. LocalOps, Dirty Water/Savannah Water, KEEPER-0, COMMONS, BOOK.NOTE and GlowOS appear as work or plans in later notes; establish which features shipped, were tested, or remain proposed.
profile.source: July portfolio audit and October fact sheet; no assumed validation, deployment or client result.

profile.title: Conflicts to resolve
profile.text: Older notes mention military diving, while the October fact sheet says Army combat engineer training for eight months in 2020–21. SCAD major/degree labels and schedules differ; 1540+ SAT, PTK status, service eligibility and benefit availability are asserted in planning notes but need original verification.

profile.title: Voice and boundaries
profile.text: Lead with a true scene, a choice, a consequence and a changed question. Let the story show reliability, curiosity and collaborative leadership; treatment and housing details stay optional, and private health/service records do not belong in public portfolio pages.
